description: HP-86 is the Registration and Licensing Authority (R&LA) located in Dharampur, Mandi district of Himachal Pradesh. It functions under the Sub Divisional Officer (Civil) and is responsible for vehicle registration, driving licenses, and transport-related administrative tasks for the Dharampur sub-division.
address: Office of the Sub Divisional Officer (Civil), Dharampur, District Mandi, Himachal Pradesh
